The second predicate `(alive ?x - entity)` simply states that an entity is alive. These predicates have completely different semantics. The first describes a social interaction, while the second describes a state of being. They are not semantically equivalent and cannot be merged. The predicates also have different arguments and used in different operators, so merging them would introduce unnecessary complexity and potentially break existing PDDL logic.
